function.name: search_and_play
function.description: Search YouTube and start playback on the local JARVIS media engine. The operation is asynchronous and returns immediately after the request is queued.

query.description: A video, song, channel, or natural-language search query.

function.name: control_player
function.description: Control the currently playing local JARVIS media session.

volume.description: Target volume percentage. Required when action is volume.
